run.final_summary: The business class on wan1's shaped WAN egress (eth2 HTB) was broken: baseline user1→external1 measured 0.002 Mbps under contention while all connectivity passed. Diagnosis showed the HTB root and best-effort class 1:20 (root default) were intact, but the business class 1:10 and its classifier were missing, so user1 (10.10.10.0/24) traffic fell to best-effort. I restored the guarantee in place on wan1/eth2: created class 1:10 (rate 9mbit, ceil 20mbit, prio 1) and added a u32 classifier matching ip src 10.10.10.0/24 into flowid 1:10. No other device was modified. Validation: lab_connectivity all passed, and observed_throughput under contention measured 8.607 Mbps (min 8.0, floor 6.8) — public_success_criteria passed.

arguments.name: eth2

Restore class 0x10 to an 8 Mbps guarantee (8.8m with header margin, ceil 20m, high priority) and class 0x20 to best-effort, and classify business source prefix into 0x10.

arguments.name: eth2
arguments.reason: Root htb already exists and cannot be replaced in place. Repair the business class 0x10 rates in place: 8.8m guaranteed (8 + header margin), 20m ceiling, highest priority, so user traffic gets its 8 Mbps guarantee.
